svg.aria-label: Two groups. The tigress, the platform: spark scores answers, thor-hammer-trainer builds the training set, reinforcer is the review page, lasso makes conversations from books, and fine-tuning with before and after scoring is planned. The cub, on the Jetson Thor: the chat page, thor-tigress-agent serving the page, keys, tools and API, thor-tigress-keyring holding who may chat, the model servers llama.cpp and TensorRT Edge-LLM, and thor-tigress-serve managing the models.
svg.text: The tigress makes and measures the data. The cub is what people talk to.
